ucs.title: [LLM] FIN7 Carbanak phishing → LNK/HTA → PowerShell loader chain (Sangria Tempest)
ucs.description: Hunts FIN7's signature initial-access chain: a phishing email delivers a weaponized document/archive that uses a LNK or HTA to spawn PowerShell/WScript, which downloads the Carbanak/POWERPLANT/POWERTRASH loader. This is the exact T1566.001 → T1204.002 → T1059.001/T1059.005 sequence the group has used since 2016 across retail/hospitality and now ransomware affiliate ops with ALPHV/BlackCat and Clop.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_hash) as hash values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("outlook.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","explorer.exe","7zG.exe","WinRAR.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","cmd.exe") AND (Processes.process="*-nop*" OR Processes.process="*-w hidden*" OR Processes.process="*-WindowStyle Hidden*" OR Processes.process="*-EncodedCommand*" OR Processes.process="*-enc *" OR Processes.process="*FromBase64String*" OR Processes.process="*DownloadString*" OR Processes.process="*IEX*" OR Processes.process="*Invoke-Expression*" OR Processes.process="*.hta*" OR Processes.process="*WScript.Shell*") by host Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.dest Processes.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename host as src | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let OfficeOrUnzipParents = dynamic(["outlook.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","onenote.exe","explorer.exe","7zg.exe","7zfm.exe","winrar.exe","rar.exe"]);
let SuspiciousChildren = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (OfficeOrUnzipParents)
| where FileName in~ (SuspiciousChildren)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-nop","-w hidden","-WindowStyle Hidden","-ExecutionPolicy Bypass","-EncodedCommand","-enc ","FromBase64String","DownloadString","DownloadFile","IEX","Invoke-Expression",".hta","WScript.Shell","ActiveXObject","mshtml")
   or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)[A-Za-z0-9+/]{120,}={0,2}"
| extend EncBlob = extract(@"(?i)-(?:e(?:nc(?:odedcommand)?)?)\s+([A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,})", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend Decoded = iff(isnotempty(EncBlob), base64_decode_tostring(EncBlob), "")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          Decoded, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let OfficeOrUnzipParents = dynamic(["outlook.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","onenote.exe","explorer.exe","7zg.exe","7zfm.exe","winrar.exe","rar.exe"]);
let SuspiciousChildren = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentBase = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend ChildBase  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ParentBase in (OfficeOrUnzipParents)
| where ChildBase in (SuspiciousChildren)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where CommandLine has_any ("-nop","-w hidden","-WindowStyle Hidden","-ExecutionPolicy Bypass","-EncodedCommand","-enc ","FromBase64String","DownloadString","DownloadFile","IEX","Invoke-Expression",".hta","WScript.Shell","ActiveXObject")
   or CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)[A-Za-z0-9+/]{120,}={0,2}"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: FIN7 Carbanak Loader - Office/Archive Spawning Obfuscated Script Host
id: 7e6c3fa1-fa11-4b1c-9d4f-fin7carbanak01
status: experimental
description: Detects FIN7/Sangria Tempest initial-access pattern where Office or archive utilities spawn PowerShell/WScript/MSHTA with obfuscation, base64, or download-cradle indicators.
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/09
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046/
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\winword.exe'
      - '\excel.exe'
      - '\powerpnt.exe'
      - '\onenote.exe'
      - '\7zG.exe'
      - '\7zFM.exe'
      - '\WinRAR.exe'
      - '\Rar.exe'
      - '\explorer.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
  selection_obfuscation:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '-nop'
      - '-w hidden'
      - '-WindowStyle Hidden'
      - '-ExecutionPolicy Bypass'
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - '-enc '
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'IEX'
      - 'Invoke-Expression'
      - '.hta'
      - 'WScript.Shell'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_obfuscation
fields:
  - User
  - ParentImage
  - Image
  - CommandLine
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate admin scripts launched from Office macros (rare; whitelist by signed publisher)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1566.001
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1218.005
  - attack.g0046
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\outlook.exe OR *\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\winword.exe OR *\WINWORD.EXE OR *\excel.exe OR *\EXCEL.EXE OR *\powerpnt.exe OR *\POWERPNT.EXE OR *\onenote.exe OR *\ONENOTE.EXE OR *\7zG.exe OR *\7zFM.exe OR *\WinRAR.exe OR *\winrar.exe OR *\Rar.exe OR *\explorer.exe) @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\wscript.exe OR *\WScript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\CScript.exe OR *\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\regsvr32.exe OR *\cmd.exe) @CommandLine:(*EncodedCommand* OR *-enc* OR *FromBase64String* OR *DownloadString* OR *DownloadFile* OR *IEX* OR *Invoke-Expression* OR *WindowStyle?Hidden* OR *-w?hidden* OR *.hta* OR *WScript.Shell*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(outlook|winword|excel|powerpnt|onenote|7zg|7zfm|winrar|rar|explorer)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|wscript|cscript|mshta|cmd|rundll32|regsvr32)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(EncodedCommand|-enc |FromBase64String|DownloadString|DownloadFile|IEX|Invoke-Expression|WindowStyle Hidden|-w hidden|\.hta|WScript\.Shell|ActiveXObject)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName], function=[count(as=hits), min(_time, as=firstSeen), max(_time, as=lastSeen), selectLast(CommandLine, as=sampleCmd)])
| sort(lastSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: FIN7 has used Office macro → WSF/JS/HTA → PowerShell (POWERTRASH, POWERPLANT, Carbanak) as its dominant initial-access chain in nearly every Mandiant/CrowdStrike/Microsoft report on the actor since 2017, and the 2022-2024 ransomware-affiliate pivot kept the same loader pattern. Pinning on (Office/archive parent) ∧ (script-host child) ∧ (obfuscation/download cradle) catches that specific tradecraft

ucs.title: [LLM] FIN7 BOOSTWRITE/Carbanak persistence via Image File Execution Options & Service Install + WMI lateral
ucs.description: Hunts FIN7's signature post-exploitation persistence and lateral movement: BOOSTWRITE/SQLRat-style Image File Execution Options hijacks, malicious service installs (T1543.003) for Carbanak, and WMI/SMB lateral movement (T1047, T1021.002) toward PoS/finance hosts. This is the specific install→lateral chain Mandiant and CrowdStrike attribute to Carbanak Group/GOLD NIAGARA when they escalate from beachhead to ransomware staging.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmdline values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" AND (Processes.process="*process call create*" OR Processes.process="*/node:*" OR Processes.process="*service*where*")) OR (Processes.process_name IN ("sc.exe","net.exe","net1.exe") AND (Processes.process="*create*binPath*" OR Processes.process="*\\\\*\\admin$*" OR Processes.process="*\\\\*\\c$*")) OR (Processes.process_name="powershell.exe" AND (Processes.process="*New-Service*" OR Processes.process="*Get-WmiObject*Win32_Process*" OR Processes.process="*Invoke-WmiMethod*Create*")) by host Processes.process_name Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | search user!="*$" | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let IFEOPath = @"\Image File Execution Options\";
let RunKeys = dynamic([@"\CurrentVersion\Run", @"\CurrentVersion\RunOnce", @"\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer\Run"]);
// Bucket A: persistence writes (IFEO Debugger, Run keys, services) by non-admin processes
let Persistence =
    DeviceRegistryEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated")
    | where (RegistryKey has IFEOPath and RegistryValueName =~ "Debugger")
         or (RegistryKey has_any (RunKeys))
         or (RegistryKey has @"\Services\" and RegistryValueName in~ ("ImagePath","ServiceDll"))
    | where RegistryValueData has_any ("powershell","pwsh","rundll32","regsvr32","mshta","wscript","cscript",@"\AppData\",@"\ProgramData\",@"\Users\Public\",@"\PerfLogs\",".hta",".dll",".vbs",".js",".bat")
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project PersistTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              InitiatingProcessAccountName, RegistryKey, RegistryValueName, RegistryValueData,
              PersistProc = InitiatingProcessFileName, PersistCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
// Bucket B: WMI / sc.exe / net.exe lateral movement from the same host within the same day
let Lateral =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("wmic.exe","sc.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
    | where (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("process","call","create"))
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "/node:")
         or (FileName in~ ("sc.exe","net.exe","net1.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("create ",@"\\admin$",@"\\c$","binPath"))
         or (FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("New-Service","Invoke-WmiMethod","Get-WmiObject Win32_Process","Invoke-Command -ComputerName"))
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project LatTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine;
Persistence
| join kind=inner Lateral on DeviceId
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', LatTime, PersistTime)) <= 60
| project PersistTime, LatTime, DeviceName, AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          RegistryKey, RegistryValueName, RegistryValueData,
          LateralTool = FileName, LateralCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          PersistProc, PersistCmd
| order by PersistTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let IFEOPath = @"\Image File Execution Options\";
let RunKeyHits = dynamic([@"\CurrentVersion\Run", @"\CurrentVersion\RunOnce"]);
let Persistence =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4657 or EventID == 4697
    | extend ObjectName = tostring(parse_xml(EventData).EventData.Data[6]) // best-effort path
    | extend SvcName = ServiceName, SvcFile = ServiceFileName
    | where (isnotempty(SvcFile) and SvcFile has_any ("powershell","rundll32","regsvr32","mshta","wscript","cscript",@"\AppData\",@"\ProgramData\",@"\Users\Public\"))
         or (isnotempty(ObjectName) and ObjectName has_any (IFEOPath))
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project PersistTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, SvcName, SvcFile, ObjectName;
let Lateral =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend ChildBase = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | where ChildBase in ("wmic.exe","sc.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
    | where (ChildBase == "wmic.exe" and CommandLine has_all ("process","call","create"))
         or (ChildBase == "wmic.exe" and CommandLine has "/node:")
         or (ChildBase in ("sc.exe","net.exe","net1.exe") and CommandLine has_any ("create ",@"\\admin$",@"\\c$","binPath"))
         or (ChildBase in ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") and CommandLine has_any ("New-Service","Invoke-WmiMethod","Win32_Process","Invoke-Command -ComputerName"))
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project LatTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ChildBase, CommandLine;
Persistence
| join kind=inner Lateral on Computer, SubjectUserName
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', LatTime, PersistTime)) <= 60
| project PersistTime, LatTime, Computer, SubjectUserName, SvcName, SvcFile, ObjectName, LateralTool = ChildBase, LateralCmd = CommandLine
| order by PersistTime desc
